:::{#def-cartesian-product}
#### Ordered pair and Cartesian product

An **ordered pair** $(a, b)$ is a pair of objects listed in order,
with $a$ first and $b$ second;
two ordered pairs are equal, $(a, b) = (c, d)$,
when $a = c$ and $b = d$.

The **Cartesian product** of sets $A$ and $B$,
written $A \times B$,
is the set of ordered pairs whose first entry is in $A$
and whose second entry is in $B$:

$$A \times B \eqdef \set{(a, b) : a \in A \text{ and } b \in B}$$

:::
